title: The End of the Double Random Current
summary: The Ising correlation function can be expressed in terms of connectivity probabilities of a random graph known as the double random current. In 2016, Duminil-Copin asked whether this random graph only has one topological end. One-endedness implies that free and wired random-cluster measures are equal and that any translation-invariant Gibbs measure of the Ising model is a convex combination of the $+$ and $-$ Gibbs measures.
